pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
say to the leader of Tyre:
Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum,
Because your heart has been exalted,
and you have said, ‘I am God,
et in cathedra Dei sedi in corde maris,
and I sit in the chair of God, in the heart of the sea,’
et non deus: et dedisti cor tuum quasi cor Dei:
and not God, and because you have presented your heart as if it were the heart of God:
Behold, you are wiser than Daniel;
omne secretum non est absconditum a te:
no secret is concealed from you.
in sapientia et prudentia tua fecisti tibi fortitudinem,
By your wisdom and prudence, you have made yourself strong,
et acquisisti aurum et argentum in thesauris tuis:
and you have acquired gold and silver for your storehouses.
By the multitude of your wisdom,
et in negotiatione tua multiplicasti tibi fortitudinem,
and by your business dealings, you have multiplied strength for yourself.
et elevatum est cor tuum in robore tuo:
And your heart has been exalted by your strength.
Therefore, thus says the Lord God:
Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum quasi cor dei,
Because your heart has been exalted as if it were the heart of God,
idcirco ecce ego adducam super te alienos,
for this reason, behold, I will lead over you foreigners,
robustissimos gentium: et nudabunt gladios suos super pulchritudinem sapientiæ tuæ,
the most robust among the Gentiles. And they will bare their swords over the beauty of your wisdom,
and they will defile your beauty.
et morieris in interitu occisorum in corde maris.
And you will die the death of those slain in the heart of the sea.
Deus ego sum, coram interficientibus te,
in the presence of those who are destroying you,
before the hand of those who are killing you,
though you are a man, and not God?
Morte incircumcisorum morieris in manu alienorum,
You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hand of foreigners.
Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre,
and you shall say to him:
You were the seal of similitudes,
You were with the delights of the Paradise of God.
Every precious stone was your covering:
et smaragdus: aurum, opus decoris tui:
The work of your beauty was of gold,
et foramina tua, in die qua conditus es, præparata sunt.
and your fissures were ready in the day when you were formed.
et posui te in monte sancto Dei:
and I stationed you on the holy mountain of God.
You have walked in the midst of stones containing fire.
perfectus in viis tuis a die conditionis tuæ,
You were perfect in your ways, from the day of your formation,
donec inventa est iniquitas in te.
until iniquity was found in you.
In multitudine negotiationis tuæ repleta sunt interiora tua iniquitate,
By the multitude of your business dealings, your interior was filled with iniquity,
et ejeci te de monte Dei,
And I cast you away from the mountain of God,
o cherub protegens, de medio lapidum ignitorum.
O protecting cherub, from the midst of the stones containing fire.
Et elevatum est cor tuum in decore tuo;
And your heart was exalted by your beauty;
perdidisti sapientiam tuam in decore tuo:
you have destroyed your own wisdom by your beauty.
I have cast you to the ground.
ante faciem regum dedi te ut cernerent te.
I have presented you before the face of kings, so that they may examine you.
by the multitude of your iniquities and by the iniquity of your business dealings.
producam ergo ignem de medio tui,
I will produce a fire from your midst,
et dabo te in cinerem super terram,
and I will make you into ashes upon the earth,
in the sight of all who are watching you.
Omnes qui viderint te in gentibus,
All who gaze upon you among the Gentiles will be stupefied over you.
You were made out of nothing,
Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
and you shall prophesy about it.
et dices: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
And you shall say: Thus says the Lord God:
and I will be glorified in your midst.
And they shall know that I am the Lord,
when I will have executed judgments in her,
and when I will have been sanctified in her.
And I will send a pestilence upon her,
and there will be blood in her streets.
et corruent interfecti in medio ejus gladio per circuitum,
And they will fall, slain by the sword, on every side in her midst.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.
Et non erit ultra domui Israël offendiculum amaritudinis,
And the house of Israel will no longer be a stumbling block of bitterness,
et spina dolorem inferens undique per circuitum eorum qui adversantur eis:
nor a thorn bringing pain everywhere around them, to those who turn against them.
et scient quia ego Dominus Deus.
And they shall know that I am the Lord God.”
Quando congregavero domum Israël de populis in quibus dispersi sunt,
“When I will have gathered together the house of Israel, from the peoples among whom they have been dispersed,
I shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the Gentiles.
And they shall live in their own land,
which I gave to my servant Jacob.
And they shall live within it securely.
And they shall live in confidence,
cum fecero judicia in omnibus qui adversantur eis per circuitum:
when I will have executed judgments upon all those who turn against them on every side.
et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum.
And they shall know that I am the Lord their God.”
